finding.summary: Login sessions never expire, allowing indefinite reuse of a stolen or leaked session.

claims.text: The requirement that sessions never expire removes an essential security control: after a session token is stolen, leaked, or left active on an unattended device, an attacker could retain access indefinitely and users/operators would have no automatic time-bound invalidation.

recommendations: Define a bounded session lifetime based on risk (for example, short-lived access tokens with refresh tokens, and an absolute maximum session age), plus revocation on logout, password change, suspicious activity, and refresh-token rollover/reuse detection.
